Fills a panel with a color.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Color", 10, 10, 300, 140, Desktop(), 3)
p   = CreatePanel(10, 10, 100, 80, win)
SetPanelColor p, 255, 120, 0
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param panel  Handle of a panel.
@param red    Red part, 0 to 255.
@param green  Green part, 0 to 255.
@param blue   Blue part, 0 to 255.
